subtitle.zh: Jon 为《The Witness》开了开发博客，我也快会写点全局光照实现上的细节。
subtitle.en: Jon starts a development blog for The Witness, and more detail on the global illumination implementation is coming.

translator.note: 这是作者宣布加入《The Witness》项目、并预告自己后续文章的一篇短贴，是个人博客与《The Witness》之间的连接点，如实照译，没有补充背景。`Jon`、`The Witness` 按术语表保留英文/书名号；`global illumination` 按表作「全局光照」。

blocks.en: Jon has recently started a [development blog](http://the-witness.net/news/) about The Witness, the game that we have been working on during the last few months. So far there are a few posts about the technology and the aesthetics of the game and I’ll soon write a bit more about the global illumination implementation in some more detail. Keep an eye on it!
blocks.zh: Jon 最近为《The Witness》开了一个[开发博客](http://the-witness.net/news/)，这就是我们过去几个月一直在做的游戏。目前已经有几篇讲游戏技术和美术风格的帖子，我很快也会更详细地写一点全局光照的实现。记得盯着点！
